Please see this issue concerning the order of plugin messages received when a plugin synchronously replies to a message (e.g. grib, xgrib, OCPN draw etc.)
I had been relying on getting a synchronous reply to a message from these. Suddenly this no longer works.
Can SKS enlighten me what should be happening here? Is there a correct order?
I am struggling to understand why this has suddenly changed and what I can rely on.
